name: Flex Your Ping And FPS!
desc:
Welcome to Flex Your Ping And FPS!

This is a game where you can test the performance of your device and compare it with players all around the world.

Show off your fps and ping and have the best stats in the server.

This game is fully VR and console compatible, so you can play it on any device you love.

Optimized for maximum FPS.

Follow Kaks4pex: https://www.roblox.com/users/2584823512/profile and join the Group for Gravity Coil.

Make sure to follow Roblox TOS to avoid getting banned!

Commands:
.hideguis
.unhideguis
